purpose: Compact daily semantic-matching profile. Designed to be sent to an LLM repeatedly with low token overhead. THIS IS A SYNTHETIC EXAMPLE CANDIDATE.

matching_instruction: Judge what the person would actually do day to day, not the advertised title. Score career_fit purely on the work and the evidence.
